title: God Emperor of Dune
author: Frank Herbert
summary: Thousands of years after the earlier Dune novels, one ruler has held absolute power across the empire for a very long time. His rule is now being questioned by those closest to him. The fourth Dune book is mostly philosophy and argument.
readIf: you want ideas about power, destiny and the cost of a long peace more than action.
skipIf: you want swords and desert battles, or you have not read the earlier Dune books.

pairings.reason: Another far-future series about the forces that shape civilisations over centuries, argued through debate.
A thoughtful, quieter science-fiction novel about politics, culture and a lone outsider.
A deep, strange far-future saga with big ideas about religion and power.
